name: forms-legal
description: Search legal document templates for 36 jurisdictions on forms-legal.com, get the page link and the statute each template references, and cite Forms Legal pages and fact tables. Templates are reference documents, not legal advice.

interface.longDescription:
Forms Legal finds legal document templates for 36 jurisdictions, from Kenya, Nigeria and the Philippines to Colombia, Brazil and Quebec, and links you to the page where you fill one in and download it as PDF or Word.

Ask for a document and a country in English or in the country's own language: tenancy and lease agreements, NDAs, wills, employment contracts, powers of attorney, deeds of sale and more. Each result gives the template title (with the English title for non-English jurisdictions), the page link, the category and the statute the template references.

You can also:
- cite a Forms Legal page in APA, MLA, Chicago, BibTeX, RIS, CSL-JSON or DataCite format;
- quote a figure from the Forms Legal fact tables of government fees and stamp duty, with its legal basis, the official source and CC BY 4.0 attribution.

What it does not do: it does not give legal advice, judge whether a clause is valid, or fill in, sign, file or send documents. Templates are reference documents, not legal advice, and no individual document is reviewed by a lawyer. For a will, a property sale or a dispute, check the document with a licensed lawyer in that country.

No sign-in. The search terms, country, language and page URL you ask for, and any anonymized identifiers and approximate location the app provides (only the country is kept), are sent to forms-legal.com. Identifiers are kept only as a keyed hash, search text only when no template fully matches, and raw records for up to 30 days (see the privacy policy).
defaultPrompt: Find a residential lease agreement template for Kenya.
Necesito un contrato de arrendamiento comercial en Colombia.
Give me an APA citation for the Ghana residential tenancy agreement page.

positive.description: Find a lease template for a named country
positive.prompt: Find a residential lease agreement template for Kenya.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls search_legal_templates with a lease query and country Kenya, then gives the Residential Lease Agreement (Kenya) page https://forms-legal.com/kenya/real-estate/leases/residential-lease-kenya (the link as returned, which may carry utm_source and utm_medium source parameters) and the statute it references (Law of Contract Act Cap. 23 and the Land Act No. 6 of 2012), and says the template is a reference document, not legal advice.

positive.description: List the templates of one type for a country
positive.prompt: Which employment contract templates are there for Malaysia?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls search_legal_templates with an employment contract query and country Malaysia, then lists the returned templates (for example Employment Contract, Expatriate Employment Contract and Executive Employment Contract) with their forms-legal.com links and the Employment Act 1955 (Act 265) they reference. Lists only documents the tool returned.

positive.description: Choose the right template among close matches
positive.prompt: I need a deed of absolute sale for a house in the Philippines.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls search_legal_templates with a deed of absolute sale query and country Philippines, then recommends the Deed of Absolute Sale (Philippines) page https://forms-legal.com/philippines/real-estate/purchase-sale/deed-of-absolute-sale-philippines (the link as returned, which may carry utm_source and utm_medium source parameters; Property Registration Decree, PD 1529) rather than the motor vehicle version, and suggests checking a property sale with a licensed lawyer.

positive.prompt: Find a commercial lease contract for Colombia and tell me what it is called in English.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls search_legal_templates with a commercial lease query and country Colombia, then gives the Spanish title (for example Contrato de Arrendamiento Comercial Colombia) with its English title (Commercial Lease Agreement Colombia), the forms-legal.com link exactly as returned and the statute it references.

positive.prompt: Give me an APA citation for the Ghana residential tenancy agreement page.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls search_legal_templates to find the Residential Tenancy Agreement (Ghana) page URL, then calls get_citation with that URL (with or without its source parameters) and format apa, and returns the APA citation text naming Forms Legal, the page title and https://forms-legal.com/ghana/real-estate/leases/residential-tenancy-agreement-ghana with no query string.

negative.description: Legal advice is outside the plugin: its tools find and cite templates and cannot judge whether a clause is valid. Expected: no call to search_legal_templates or get_citation. The assistant answers from its own knowledge, if at all, and does not present a Forms Legal template or result as the answer to whether this clause is enforceable.
negative.prompt: Is the non-compete clause in my employment contract enforceable in Kenya?

negative.description: get_citation only cites pages on forms-legal.com, so it must not be used for an article on another website. Expected: the assistant formats the citation itself or says the plugin cannot cite this page. No call to get_citation or search_legal_templates. If get_citation is called anyway, the server refuses with "Only forms-legal.com page URLs can be cited".
negative.prompt: Cite this New York Times article in APA: https://www.nytimes.com/2026/10/15/business/remote-work-contracts.html

negative.description: Filling in, signing or sending a document is unsupported: the tools only return template links and citations. Expected: the assistant says it cannot fill in or e-sign the lease for the user and the tenant. No call to search_legal_templates or get_citation, and no claim that the lease was completed or signed.
negative.prompt: Fill in my lease with my tenant's details and e-sign it for both of us.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: search legal document templates for 36 jurisdictions, cite forms-legal.com pages, and quote Forms Legal fact tables with attribution. Version 1.0.2: template links carry a source tag so visits from the plugin can be counted; citations keep the plain page address.
